field_principles.adaptation_curve: Per-family (online - static) gain as families stream in -- shows whether adaptation compounds (the continuous-self-learning signature) or is flat.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. An online-adaptation gain AND an honest static-is-the-ceiling null are BOTH COMPLETE -- both are valid self-learning findings.
field_principles.model_specs: The Tier-1 online-reweighting rule (per-feature precision update) + the family stream protocol; required methodology.
field_principles.online_adaptation_helps: BARE bool: true iff online-reweighted cross-family delta exceeds static AND the (online-static) CI95 excludes 0 -- the self-learning value verdict.
field_principles.online_cross_family_delta: BARE float: the online-reweighted selector's held-out-family delta -- the Tier-1 self-learning result.
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism precondition; the family stream order + reweighting reproducible.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash of the folds + reweighting trace; lets a third party re-run.
field_principles.static_cross_family_delta: BARE float: the static set-encoder's held-out-family delta -- the no-adaptation baseline.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: BARE bool=false -- learned selector with online weight updates, no demo execution and no fine-tuning.

set_encoder_config.architecture_note: Permutation-equivariant DeepSets scorer: per-candidate MLP embedding, mean/max pooled full-set context, and per-candidate logits conditioned on that context.
set_encoder_config.cross_candidate_conditioning: vote priors, self-consistency margins, modal-grid agreement, duplicate counts, shape/palette family indicators, and DeepSets mean/max latent pooling over all candidates
set_encoder_config.imbalance_loss: class_weighted_bce_with_positive_task_minibatches; negative-only tasks are scored held-out but do not form training minibatches
set_encoder_config.set_attention_reference: CPU-fast fallback for the Set-LLM set-attention-mask / Set-Encoder cross-candidate attention lever; still consumes the full candidate set without positional features.

tier1_online_reweighting_rule.current_family_feedback: not used until after every task in that family is scored
